entities.summary: The Encyclopedia of Triangle Centers (ETC) is an online list of thousands of points or "centers" associated with the geometry of a triangle. This resource is hosted at the University of Evansville. It started from a list of 400 triangle centers published in the 1998 book Triangle Centers and Central Triangles by Clark Kimberling. Encyclopedia of Triangle Centers is a website. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
